senses.en: happening often or found in many places
shared by two or more people or groups

ex.en: Heavy rain is common here during the summer.
ex.zh: 这里夏天经常下大雨。

ex.en: Governments should address the common challenges that prevent rural communities from accessing affordable healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府应解决阻碍农村社区获得可负担医疗服务的共同难题。

col: have something in common｜有共同之处
tip: common指常见或共有；ordinary强调普通、不特别。

senses.en: Produce tears because of sadness, pain, or strong emotion.
Call out loudly because of strong emotion or urgent need.
A loud sound expressing emotion or attracting attention.

ex.en: The baby began to cry when her toy fell.
ex.zh: 玩具掉了，宝宝就哭了起来。

ex.en: Young children may cry when separated from their parents, so schools should provide a welcoming environment.
ex.zh: 幼儿与父母分开时可能会哭，因此学校应营造亲切友好的环境。

col: have a good cry｜痛哭一场
tip: 过去式cried；现在分词crying；表示喊叫常用cry out。

senses.en: on certain occasions, but not always or regularly

ex.en: I sometimes take the longer route home through the park.
ex.zh: 我有时会绕远路穿过公园回家。

ex.en: Working from home sometimes improves productivity, although its benefits depend on suitable equipment and a quiet environment.
ex.zh: 居家办公有时能提高效率，不过其益处取决于合适的设备和安静的环境。

tip: sometimes是有时；some time是一段时间。

senses.en: The town or city where you grew up or come from.

ex.en: I return to my hometown every summer to visit relatives.
ex.zh: 我每年夏天都回家乡探望亲人。

ex.en: Many graduates leave their hometown to seek better employment opportunities in larger urban centres.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生离开家乡，前往更大的城市寻求更好的就业机会。

col: return to your hometown｜回到家乡
tip: 可指小镇或城市，不一定是出生地。

senses.en: A required or achieved level of quality or performance.
Generally accepted, regularly used, or meeting an established requirement.

ex.en: The food here is always of a high standard.
ex.zh: 这里的食物品质一向很高。

ex.en: Governments should enforce strict safety standards to ensure that new housing protects residents from avoidable risks.
ex.zh: 政府应严格执行安全标准，确保新建住房保护居民免受可避免的风险。

tip: 达到标准用meet a standard；生活水平用standard of living。

senses.en: Having falling snow or frequent snowfall.
Covered with snow.

ex.en: We stayed indoors and baked bread on that snowy afternoon.
ex.zh: 那个下雪的下午，我们待在屋里烤面包。

ex.en: In snowy regions, reliable public transport requires regular road maintenance and vehicles designed for winter conditions.
ex.zh: 在多雪地区，可靠的公共交通需要定期道路养护和适合冬季路况的车辆。

tip: snowy可描述天气，也可指地面等被雪覆盖。

senses.en: A place or object for someone to sit on.
To provide a sitting place or have room for seated people.
A position as a member of an elected body.

ex.en: She saved me a seat near the front.
ex.zh: 她在靠前的位置给我留了一个座位。

ex.en: Providing more seats on public transport would make daily travel easier for older passengers and families.
ex.zh: 在公共交通工具上增加座位，会让老年乘客和家庭的日常出行更方便。

tip: sit是不及物动词；seat常接人，be seated表就座。

senses.en: a musical instrument played by hitting its stretched surface
a large cylindrical container for storing liquids or other materials
to play a drum or tap something repeatedly

ex.en: The little boy beat the drum with both hands.
ex.zh: 小男孩用双手敲鼓。

ex.en: Learning to play the drum can help children develop coordination and participate in group performances.
ex.zh: 学习打鼓能帮助儿童培养协调能力，并参与集体表演。

tip: play the drums常指打鼓；drum也可指大圆桶。

senses.en: the city where a country or region's government is based
money or assets used to start or operate a business
a letter in its large form

ex.en: We visited the capital and explored its busy markets.
ex.zh: 我们游览了首都，逛了那里热闹的市场。

ex.en: Small businesses often struggle to obtain enough capital to invest in new equipment and staff training.
ex.zh: 小企业往往难以筹集足够资金，用于购置新设备和培训员工。

tip: 表示资金时通常不可数；表示大写字母时可数。

senses.en: A member of the police.
A member of the armed forces with authority to command.
Someone with an official role in an organisation or government.

ex.en: A police officer helped us find the station.
ex.zh: 一位警察帮我们找到了车站。

ex.en: A local housing officer can advise residents on applying for affordable accommodation and accessing financial support.
ex.zh: 当地住房事务官员可以指导居民申请可负担住房并获取经济援助。

tip: officer可指警察或军官，具体含义看搭配。

senses.en: Clothing hanging from the waist, without separate sections for legs.
To move around the edge of something.
To avoid dealing directly with a difficult subject.

ex.en: Her blue skirt swayed as she walked upstairs.
ex.zh: 她上楼时，蓝色裙子轻轻摆动。

ex.en: Public discussions often skirt the issue of who should pay for environmental protection.
ex.zh: 公共讨论往往回避谁应承担环保费用这一问题。

col: skirt the edge of｜沿……边缘行进
tip: skirt是裙子；dress通常指连衣裙。

senses.en: A large boat carrying people or goods, especially at sea.
To send goods somewhere by sea, air, or land.

ex.en: We watched a huge ship glide into the harbour.
ex.zh: 我们看着一艘巨轮缓缓驶入港口。

ex.en: Many countries ship agricultural products overseas, making reliable transport networks essential for economic growth.
ex.zh: 许多国家向海外运送农产品，因此可靠的运输网络对经济增长至关重要。

tip: ship作动词不只指海运，也可指陆运或空运。

senses.en: the musical sounds made by birds and some other animals such as  whales

col: the song of the lark｜云雀的鸣唱

senses.en: Different from usual, often in an important or valued way.
Intended for a particular purpose or person.
A specially priced product or a featured restaurant dish.

ex.en: We saved this special cake for your birthday.
ex.zh: 我们把这个特别的蛋糕留到了你生日时享用。

ex.en: Schools should provide special equipment so that students with disabilities can participate fully in classroom activities.
ex.zh: 学校应提供专用设备，让残障学生能够充分参与课堂活动。

tip: specially强调专门；especially常表示尤其。

senses.en: a thick, strong cord made from twisted fibres
to tie or secure something with rope

ex.en: We tied the boat to a post with rope.
ex.zh: 我们用绳子把船系在一根柱子上。

ex.en: Climbers should inspect their ropes regularly because damaged equipment can put the entire group at risk.
ex.zh: 登山者应定期检查绳索，因为损坏的装备可能危及整个团队。

col: a length of rope｜一段绳子
rope off an area｜用绳围起一片区域
tip: 材料泛指用rope；一根绳可说a rope。

senses.en: To gather things together or keep objects as a hobby
To go somewhere and bring someone or something away
To receive or gather money from people

ex.en: I collect smooth stones whenever we visit the beach.
ex.zh: 每次去海边，我都会收集光滑的石头。

ex.en: Researchers collect data from local households to assess how transport policies affect daily travel habits.
ex.zh: 研究人员收集当地家庭的数据，以评估交通政策如何影响日常出行习惯。

tip: 英式英语collect someone可指去接某人。

senses.en: a live musical performance given before an audience

ex.en: We enjoyed an outdoor concert in the park yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在公园欣赏了一场露天音乐会。

ex.en: Free public concerts can make cultural activities more accessible and encourage residents to use shared urban spaces.
ex.zh: 免费公共音乐会能让更多人参与文化活动，并鼓励居民使用城市公共空间。

tip: 去听音乐会用 go to a concert。

senses.en: A wild animal with pointed ears and a bushy tail.
To confuse someone or make a problem difficult to solve.

ex.en: A fox slipped through the garden before sunrise.
ex.zh: 日出前，一只狐狸悄悄穿过花园。

ex.en: The red fox can adapt to urban environments where food is readily available from human activity.
ex.zh: 赤狐能够适应城市环境，因为人类活动使食物很容易获取。

col: an urban fox｜城市里的狐狸
tip: 作动词表示“难倒”，主要用于英式非正式语境。

senses.en: The middle point or area of something.
A place providing particular activities, services, or facilities.
Make something the main focus of attention or activity.

ex.en: We placed a vase in the centre of the table.
ex.zh: 我们在桌子中央摆了一个花瓶。

ex.en: A new community centre could provide affordable exercise facilities and meeting spaces for local residents.
ex.zh: 新的社区中心可以为当地居民提供价格实惠的健身设施和聚会场所。

tip: centre是英式拼写，美式写center；动词常接on。

senses.en: an adult female bovine, often kept for milk
to frighten someone into obeying or giving up resistance

ex.en: A brown cow stood quietly beside the farm gate.
ex.zh: 一头棕色母牛静静地站在农场门旁。

ex.en: Improving the diet of dairy cows can increase milk production while supporting animal health.
ex.zh: 改善奶牛的饮食可以在促进动物健康的同时提高产奶量。

col: be cowed into silence｜被吓得不敢出声
tip: cow指成年母牛；cattle统称牛，不能说a cattle。

senses.en: A child who attends school.
The dark opening in the eye that lets light enter.

ex.en: Each pupil brought a leaf to the science lesson.
ex.zh: 每个学生都带了一片树叶来上科学课。

ex.en: Smaller classes may allow teachers to give each pupil more individual support and useful feedback.
ex.zh: 小班教学可能让教师为每个学生提供更多个别指导和有用的反馈。

tip: 英式英语常指中小学生；大学生用 student。

senses.en: almost not, or only to a very small degree
only just, before something else happens

ex.en: I could hardly hear you over the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 雨声太大，我几乎听不见你说话。

ex.en: Expanding roads alone is hardly sufficient to solve traffic congestion without improvements to public transport.
ex.zh: 如果不改善公共交通，仅靠拓宽道路几乎不足以解决交通拥堵。

tip: hardly意为几乎不，并非hard的副词形式。

senses.en: A sweet food baked from flour, eggs, sugar, and fat.
To cover with a thick layer or form hard lumps.

ex.en: We shared a slice of lemon cake after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，我们分着吃了一片柠檬蛋糕。

ex.en: Schools can encourage healthier eating by offering fresh fruit instead of cake at school celebrations.
ex.zh: 学校可以在校内庆祝活动中提供新鲜水果而非蛋糕，以鼓励更健康的饮食。

col: a slice of cake｜一片蛋糕
be caked in mud｜沾满厚厚的泥
tip: 整个蛋糕可数；泛指蛋糕这种食物时常不可数。

senses.en: Liked or enjoyed by many people.
Intended for ordinary people rather than specialists.

ex.en: This small café is popular with local students.
ex.zh: 这家小咖啡馆很受当地学生欢迎。

ex.en: Popular science books can encourage public interest in research by explaining discoveries in accessible language.
ex.zh: 通俗科普书籍通过用易懂的语言解释科学发现，可以激发公众对研究的兴趣。

tip: 表示受某群体欢迎，常用popular with或among。

senses.en: To break rules dishonestly to gain an unfair advantage.
To deceive someone to obtain something unfairly.
A person who acts dishonestly to gain an advantage.

ex.en: My cousin cheated by hiding cards under the table.
ex.zh: 我的表亲把牌藏在桌子下面作弊。

ex.en: Schools can discourage students from cheating by designing assessments that reward original thinking rather than memorisation.
ex.zh: 学校可以设计注重独立思考而非死记硬背的考核，减少学生作弊。

col: cheat in an exam｜考试作弊
cheat someone out of money｜骗取某人的钱
tip: cheat someone out of something指骗走某人的某物。

senses.en: A person who controls a car or another road vehicle.
Something that strongly influences or causes a development.
Software that lets a computer communicate with a device.

ex.en: The bus driver waited while I found my ticket.
ex.zh: 公交车司机等着我找到车票。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can be a major driver of economic growth in expanding cities.
ex.zh: 在不断扩张的城市，公共交通投资可以成为经济增长的重要驱动力。

col: a key driver of growth｜增长的关键驱动因素
install a driver｜安装驱动程序
tip: a driver of change指推动变化的因素。

senses.en: To succeed in doing something, especially something difficult.
To direct or control a business, team, or activity.
To cope with a situation despite difficulties or limited resources.

ex.en: I managed to carry all the bags upstairs.
ex.zh: 我总算把所有袋子都提上了楼。

ex.en: Many students manage to balance academic demands with paid employment by planning their weekly schedules carefully.
ex.zh: 许多学生通过仔细安排每周日程，设法兼顾学业要求与有薪工作。

col: manage to do something｜设法做成某事
tip: manage to do表示成功做成，不只是尝试。

senses.en: a pale yellow fat made from cream, used in food
to spread butter on food

ex.en: She spread some butter on a slice of warm bread.
ex.zh: 她在一片温热的面包上抹了些黄油。

ex.en: Replacing some butter with unsaturated oils can help people reduce their overall intake of saturated fat.
ex.zh: 用不饱和油脂替代部分黄油，有助于减少饱和脂肪的总体摄入量。

col: a knob of butter｜一小块黄油
tip: butter是黄油，cream是奶油；作食品名通常不可数。

senses.en: someone who greatly enjoys or admires a person or thing
a device or object moved to create a cooling airflow
to move air towards something, or make a feeling stronger

ex.en: As a football fan, I rarely miss a match.
ex.zh: 作为一名足球迷，我几乎不错过任何一场比赛。

ex.en: Sports fans can strengthen local communities by supporting neighbourhood teams and participating in shared events.
ex.zh: 体育迷可以通过支持社区球队、参与共同活动来增强当地社区的凝聚力。

tip: 表示“……的爱好者”用a fan of。

senses.en: the measurement of how tall someone or something is
the distance of something above the ground or sea
the time when something is strongest or most successful

ex.en: She adjusted the chair's height so her feet reached the floor.
ex.zh: 她调节了椅子的高度，让双脚能够踩到地面。

ex.en: Restricting the height of new buildings can protect historic views and preserve the character of older neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 限制新建筑的高度可以保护历史景观，并保留老街区的特色。

col: average height｜平均身高；平均高度
at a height of｜在……的高度
at the height of｜在……的鼎盛时期
tip: height 是名词；形容人高用 tall，物体高可用 high。

senses.en: to tell a story or describe events again

ex.en: My grandmother retells her favourite story every winter.
ex.zh: 奶奶每年冬天都会再讲一遍她最喜欢的故事。

ex.en: Asking students to retell a story in their own words can improve comprehension and speaking skills.
ex.zh: 让学生用自己的话复述故事，可以提高理解能力和口语技能。

col: retell in your own words｜用自己的话复述
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为retold。

senses.en: the continent west of Asia and north of Africa

ex.en: My cousin travelled across Europe by train last summer.
ex.zh: 我表亲去年夏天乘火车游历了欧洲。

ex.en: Many cities in Europe are expanding cycling networks to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 欧洲许多城市正在扩建自行车路网，以缓解交通拥堵并改善城市空气质量。

tip: Europe首字母大写，通常不加the；不等于欧盟。

senses.en: A period away from work or study for rest or travel.
An officially recognised day when many people do not work.
To spend time away from home for pleasure.

ex.en: We spent our holiday swimming and exploring quiet villages.
ex.zh: 我们假期里游泳，还探访了宁静的村庄。

ex.en: Flexible holiday arrangements can improve employee wellbeing while allowing businesses to maintain essential services throughout the year.
ex.zh: 灵活的休假安排可以改善员工福祉，同时让企业全年维持基本服务。

tip: 英式on holiday指度假；美式通常说on vacation。

senses.en: A child or young person, in informal language.
Say something playfully that is not meant to be believed.
A young goat.

ex.en: The kids built a tiny bridge across the stream.
ex.zh: 孩子们在小溪上搭了一座小桥。

ex.en: Outdoor activities can help kids develop social skills while improving their physical health.
ex.zh: 户外活动可以帮助孩子们发展社交技能，同时改善身体健康。

tip: kid较口语；正式作文中“孩子”宜用child。

senses.en: Almost, but not completely or exactly.

ex.en: I nearly missed the bus because I overslept.
ex.zh: 我睡过了头，差点没赶上公交车。

ex.en: Nearly half of the surveyed residents supported expanding public transport rather than building additional roads.
ex.zh: 受访居民中近一半支持扩建公共交通系统，而不是增建道路。

tip: nearly表示差一点达到；not nearly表示远远不。

senses.en: in or to which place

ex.en: Where are you going?
ex.zh: 你要到哪儿去？

ex.en: Where do they live?
ex.zh: 他们住在哪里？

senses.en: Moving, happening, or taking place at a low speed.
To move or happen less quickly, or make something do so.
Showing a time earlier than the correct time.

ex.en: We took a slow walk along the river.
ex.zh: 我们沿着河边慢慢散步。

ex.en: Slow progress in expanding public transport may discourage commuters from giving up their private cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通扩建进展缓慢，可能会削弱通勤者放弃私家车的意愿。

col: slow economic growth｜缓慢的经济增长
tip: slow多作形容词；修饰一般动作通常用slowly。

senses.en: Some in questions or negatives; whichever one, without restriction.
Some or whichever ones, without naming the people or things.
At all, used mainly with comparisons in questions or negatives.

ex.en: You can borrow any book from this shelf.
ex.zh: 这个书架上的书，你想借哪本都可以。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that all children can attend school without facing any financial barriers.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有儿童都能上学，不受任何经济障碍的阻碍。

col: any of these｜这些中的任何一个
tip: 疑问、否定句中常表“一些”；肯定句中常表“任何”。

senses.en: The forward part or outward-facing surface of something.
Located at or near the forward part of something.
A boundary where masses of warm and cold air meet.

ex.en: Please leave your muddy boots by the front door.
ex.zh: 请把沾满泥的靴子放在前门旁。

ex.en: Placing bicycle racks at the front of public buildings can encourage more residents to cycle.
ex.zh: 在公共建筑前部设置自行车架，可以鼓励更多居民骑车出行。

col: at the front of｜在……的前部
tip: in front of指外部前方；at the front of指前部。

senses.en: In a higher position than something else.
Greater than a particular amount, level, or standard.
In a higher place or earlier in a piece of writing.

ex.en: A small wooden shelf hangs above the kitchen sink.
ex.zh: 厨房水槽上方挂着一个小木架。

ex.en: Temperatures above the seasonal average can increase water demand and put pressure on urban supplies.
ex.zh: 高于当季平均水平的气温会增加用水需求，给城市供水带来压力。

tip: above 表示位置更高，不一定正上方，也不表示接触。

senses.en: having an even surface without rough areas or bumps
happening without problems, interruptions, or sudden movements
to make a surface even or remove its wrinkles

ex.en: This stone feels smooth and cool in my hand.
ex.zh: 这块石头握在手里又光滑又凉。

ex.en: Clear communication between departments is essential for a smooth transition to a new working system.
ex.zh: 部门之间清晰的沟通对于顺利过渡到新的工作制度至关重要。

tip: 末尾th读浊音/ð/；smoothly常形容事情进展顺利。

senses.en: A powered flying vehicle with fixed wings.

ex.en: We watched the airplane disappear behind a white cloud.
ex.zh: 我们看着飞机消失在一朵白云后面。

ex.en: Travelling by airplane connects remote communities to essential services, although it also contributes to carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 乘飞机出行让偏远社区能够获得必要服务，但也会增加碳排放。

tip: airplane常用于美式英语，英式通常用aeroplane。

senses.en: the act or freedom of choosing between different possibilities
something you can choose, or the range of available options
of especially good quality

ex.en: You have a choice between soup and salad.
ex.zh: 你可以在汤和沙拉之间选择。

ex.en: Reliable public transport gives commuters a wider choice and reduces their dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通为通勤者提供更多选择，并减少他们对私家车的依赖。

col: a wide choice of｜种类丰富的
tip: choice是名词，choose是动词；选择做某事用choose to do。

senses.en: to have your home somewhere, lead a life, or remain alive
broadcast or performed as it happens, rather than recorded
alive rather than dead

ex.en: My grandparents live in a quiet village near the coast.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母住在海边一个安静的村庄里。

ex.en: People who live near public transport often depend less on private cars for their daily journeys.
ex.zh: 住在公共交通设施附近的人日常出行往往较少依赖私家车。

col: live a healthy life｜过健康的生活
tip: 动词读/lɪv/；形容词及表示现场直播的副词读/laɪv/。

senses.en: the end of a person's or animal's life

ex.en: The old dog's death left the family deeply sad.
ex.zh: 老狗的离世让全家人深感悲伤。

ex.en: Improved access to clean drinking water has reduced deaths from preventable diseases in many communities.
ex.zh: 更便利地获得清洁饮用水，已减少了许多社区中可预防疾病导致的死亡。

tip: die是动词，dead是形容词，death是名词。

senses.en: The sixth month of the year, between May and July.

ex.en: My sister is getting married in June this year.
ex.zh: 我姐姐今年六月要结婚了。

ex.en: The community centre will open in June, providing local residents with affordable exercise classes.
ex.zh: 社区中心将于六月开放，为当地居民提供价格实惠的健身课程。

col: by the end of June｜到六月底为止
tip: 月份首字母大写；在六月用in June。

senses.en: The number after sixteen and before eighteen.

ex.en: My sister is seventeen and loves playing volleyball.
ex.zh: 我妹妹十七岁，喜欢打排球。

ex.en: The survey found that seventeen students preferred practical training to traditional classroom instruction.
ex.zh: 调查发现，十七名学生更喜欢实践培训，而非传统课堂教学。

tip: 注意与seventy（七十）区分，词尾读清。

senses.en: existing in nature rather than made by people
having an ability from birth rather than through training
normal and expected in a particular situation

ex.en: This soap is made entirely from natural ingredients.
ex.zh: 这块肥皂完全由天然原料制成。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for maintaining biodiversity and supporting communities that depend on local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地对于维持生物多样性、支持依赖当地生态系统的社区至关重要。

tip: natural指天然的；nature是名词，指自然。

senses.en: the day after Tuesday and before Thursday

ex.en: We meet for lunch every Wednesday near the library.
ex.zh: 我们每周三在图书馆附近一起吃午饭。

ex.en: The community centre offers free language classes every Wednesday to help newcomers participate in local life.
ex.zh: 社区中心每周三提供免费语言课程，帮助新来者融入当地生活。

tip: 首字母大写；on Wednesday，但every Wednesday前不加on。

senses.en: The outer limit of an object, area, or surface.
A quality that makes someone or something more competitive.
To move slowly and carefully in a particular direction.

ex.en: Keep your glass away from the edge of the table.
ex.zh: 别把你的玻璃杯放在桌子边缘。

ex.en: Practical experience can give graduates an edge over other candidates in a competitive job market.
ex.zh: 在竞争激烈的就业市场中，实践经验能让毕业生比其他求职者更有优势。

col: have an edge over｜比……有优势
tip: 表示优势时常用an edge over，指胜过某人。

senses.en: the female person or animal receiving an action
belonging to or connected with a female person or animal

ex.en: I called her after lunch to arrange a walk.
ex.zh: 午饭后我给她打了电话，约好一起散步。

ex.en: When a student requests additional support, teachers should help her access appropriate learning resources.
ex.zh: 当一名女学生请求额外支持时，教师应帮助她获取合适的学习资源。

tip: her可作宾语或接名词表所属；hers独立使用。

senses.en: The official organisation responsible for preventing crime and maintaining order.
To maintain order somewhere or ensure rules are obeyed.

ex.en: The police helped us find our missing bicycle.
ex.zh: 警方帮我们找到了丢失的自行车。

ex.en: Effective cooperation between police and local residents can improve public safety and build trust within communities.
ex.zh: 警方与当地居民的有效合作可以改善公共安全，并建立社区内部的信任。

col: police an event｜维持活动秩序
tip: the police作主语用复数；一名警察用a police officer。

senses.en: a cereal crop whose grain is commonly ground into flour

ex.en: Golden wheat swayed in the field behind our house.
ex.zh: 我们屋后的田野里，金黄的小麦随风摇曳。

ex.en: Prolonged droughts can reduce wheat harvests, raising food prices and threatening food security in vulnerable regions.
ex.zh: 长期干旱会导致小麦减产，推高食品价格，并威胁脆弱地区的粮食安全。

tip: wheat通常不可数；一粒小麦用a grain of wheat。

senses.en: Used for people or things already mentioned or understood.

senses.zh: 指性别未知或非二元者
senses.en: Used for someone of unknown or nonbinary gender.

ex.en: The children waved as they boarded the bus.
ex.zh: 孩子们一边上公交车一边挥手。

ex.en: When a student receives constructive feedback, they are more likely to identify weaknesses and improve their performance.
ex.zh: 学生收到建设性反馈后，更有可能发现不足并改善表现。

tip: 单数they也搭配are、have，不用is、has。

senses.en: the number equal to four times ten

ex.en: We waited forty minutes before the bus finally arrived.
ex.zh: 我们等了四十分钟，公交车才终于到。

ex.en: The survey found that forty percent of local residents preferred cycling to driving for short journeys.
ex.zh: 调查发现，当地百分之四十的居民在短途出行时更愿意骑车而非开车。

col: in her forties｜在她四十多岁时
tip: 拼写是forty，不是fourty；四十多岁用in one's forties。

senses.en: a period of seven days
the days or hours normally spent working each week

ex.en: I borrowed this book from the library last week.
ex.zh: 我上周从图书馆借了这本书。

ex.en: A shorter working week could improve employee wellbeing, provided that workloads are reduced rather than compressed.
ex.zh: 缩短工作周可能改善员工的身心状况，前提是减少工作量，而非把工作集中完成。

tip: last/next/this week前不加介词。

senses.en: a person's mother or father
a company that owns or controls another company
to raise and care for a child as a parent

ex.en: Each parent brought a snack for the school picnic.
ex.zh: 每位家长都为学校野餐带了一份点心。

ex.en: Schools should involve parents in educational decisions because family support plays an important role in children's learning.
ex.zh: 学校应让家长参与教育决策，因为家庭支持在孩子的学习中发挥着重要作用。

tip: parent指父母中的一位；parents通常指父母双方。

senses.en: Force air suddenly from your throat with a rough sound.
The act or sound of coughing, or an illness causing it.

ex.en: The dusty room made me cough several times.
ex.zh: 房间里的灰尘让我咳嗽了好几次。

ex.en: People with a persistent cough should seek medical advice, particularly if symptoms interfere with sleep or daily activities.
ex.zh: 持续咳嗽的人应就医咨询，尤其是在症状影响睡眠或日常活动时。

tip: gh在此发/f/；have a cough表示有咳嗽症状。

senses.en: A movable barrier controlling entry through a fence or wall.
An airport area where passengers board a plane.

ex.en: She closed the garden gate to keep the dog inside.
ex.zh: 她关上花园的门，免得狗跑出去。

ex.en: Airports should provide clear directions so passengers can reach their departure gate without unnecessary stress.
ex.zh: 机场应提供清晰的指引，让乘客无需过度紧张就能找到登机口。

tip: gate多指围墙或栅栏上的门；房间的门通常用door。

senses.en: A female parent.
Care for someone protectively, as a mother would.

ex.en: My mother taught me how to ride a bicycle.
ex.zh: 我妈妈教会了我骑自行车。

ex.en: Affordable childcare can help a mother return to work without placing excessive pressure on the family budget.
ex.zh: 负担得起的托育服务能帮助母亲重返职场，而不给家庭预算带来过大压力。

tip: 英式口语常用mum，美式口语常用mom。

senses.en: The sound someone makes when speaking or singing.
The right or opportunity to express opinions and influence decisions.
To express an opinion, feeling, or concern.

ex.en: Her gentle voice helped the frightened puppy settle down.
ex.zh: 她温柔的声音让受惊的小狗安静了下来。

ex.en: Public consultations give local residents a voice in decisions that directly affect their communities.
ex.zh: 公众咨询让当地居民有机会参与直接影响其社区的决策。

col: a voice in decisions｜决策中的发言权
tip: voice侧重人的嗓音；sound泛指声音。

senses.en: Having great value or a significant effect.
Having considerable power, influence, or status.

ex.en: Keep your important documents in this waterproof folder.
ex.zh: 把你的重要文件放在这个防水文件夹里。

ex.en: Access to reliable information plays an important role in helping citizens make informed decisions about their health.
ex.zh: 获取可靠信息对于帮助公民作出明智的健康决策起着重要作用。

col: important to someone｜对某人很重要
tip: 用It is important to do；importance是名词形式。

senses.en: having a large distance between opposite surfaces
having many things close together or being difficult to see through
flowing slowly rather than easily, like heavy cream

ex.en: She wrapped a thick blanket around her cold shoulders.
ex.zh: 她把一条厚毯子裹在冰冷的肩膀上。

ex.en: Thick layers of insulation can reduce heat loss and lower household energy bills during winter.
ex.zh: 厚厚的隔热层可以减少热量流失，降低冬季家庭能源开支。

tip: 形容液体时指黏稠，不一定表示味道浓。

senses.en: Someone who visits places for pleasure rather than work

ex.en: A tourist asked me how to reach the castle.
ex.zh: 一位游客问我怎么去城堡。

ex.en: Large numbers of tourists support local businesses but can also place pressure on public transport.
ex.zh: 大量游客为当地企业带来生意，但也可能给公共交通造成压力。

tip: tourist通常是名词，在tourist attraction中修饰名词。

senses.en: Things people throw away because they no longer need them.
Ideas or statements that are silly or untrue.

ex.en: Please put your rubbish in the bin outside.
ex.zh: 请把垃圾放进外面的垃圾桶。

ex.en: Reducing household rubbish requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of unnecessary packaging.
ex.zh: 减少生活垃圾既需要便利的回收设施，也需要提高公众对过度包装的认识。

tip: 通常不可数；英式常用词，美式常说garbage或trash。

senses.en: Make someone or something ready for an activity or situation
Make food, a document, or a plan ready for use

ex.en: I prepare my lunch before leaving home each morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上出门前都会准备好午餐。

ex.en: Schools should prepare students for employment by developing practical skills alongside their academic knowledge.
ex.zh: 学校应在传授学术知识的同时培养实用技能，让学生为就业做好准备。

col: prepare for an exam｜准备考试
tip: prepare for后接名词；prepare to后接动词原形。

senses.en: A building where a person or family lives.
To provide a place for people or things to stay.

ex.en: Their house has a small garden behind the kitchen.
ex.zh: 他们的房子在厨房后面有一个小花园。

ex.en: Local authorities could convert unused office buildings into apartments to house families in need of affordable accommodation.
ex.zh: 地方政府可以将闲置办公楼改造成公寓，为需要可负担住房的家庭提供住所。

tip: 名词读/haʊs/，动词读/haʊz/；home更强调家的归属感。

senses.en: From one side or end to the other, within something.
By using a particular method, person, or process.
From beginning to end, or from one side to another.

ex.en: Sunlight streamed through the curtains and warmed the room.
ex.zh: 阳光透过窗帘洒进来，让房间暖和起来。

ex.en: Students can develop practical skills through projects that require cooperation and creative problem solving.
ex.zh: 学生可以通过需要合作和创造性解决问题的项目来培养实践技能。

tip: through强调从内部穿过；across强调横越表面。

senses.en: very angry
behaving or thinking in an unreasonable or foolish way
extremely enthusiastic about someone or something

ex.en: Dad was mad because I broke his favourite cup.
ex.zh: 爸爸很生气，因为我打碎了他最喜欢的杯子。

ex.en: Although some residents are mad about football, public sports funding should support a wider range of activities.
ex.zh: 虽然一些居民热衷足球，但公共体育资金应支持更广泛的活动。

tip: mad at表示生气；mad about可表示痴迷。

senses.en: A female monarch, or the wife of a king.
The main egg-laying female in a social insect colony.
The chess piece that moves any distance in any direction.

ex.en: The queen waved to the crowd from her carriage.
ex.zh: 女王从马车里向人群挥手。

ex.en: In some constitutional monarchies, the queen performs ceremonial duties while elected representatives make political decisions.
ex.zh: 在一些君主立宪制国家，女王履行礼仪职责，而民选代表作出政治决策。

tip: queen 可指统治国家的女王，也可指国王的妻子。

senses.en: A large area of water surrounded by land.

ex.en: We rented a small boat and crossed the lake.
ex.zh: 我们租了一条小船，划到了湖对岸。

ex.en: Agricultural pollution can damage lake ecosystems and threaten the communities that rely on them for drinking water.
ex.zh: 农业污染会破坏湖泊生态系统，并威胁依靠湖水获取饮用水的社区。

col: the shore of a lake｜湖岸
tip: on the lake 指在湖面上；in the lake 指在湖水中。

senses.en: mathematics

ex.en: Tim’s good at math and science.
ex.zh: 蒂姆的数学和自然科学很好。

ex.en: She’s learning calculus in math class.
ex.zh: 她在数学班学微积分。

senses.en: The place where someone lives or feels they belong.
At or towards the place where you live.
Relating to your house or your own country.

ex.en: We walked home together after dinner at the café.
ex.zh: 在咖啡馆吃过晚饭后，我们一起走回家。

ex.en: Working from home can reduce commuting costs, but it may also limit social interaction among colleagues.
ex.zh: 居家办公可以降低通勤成本，但也可能限制同事之间的社交互动。

tip: home作副词时前面不加to：go home。

senses.en: many times or on many occasions

ex.en: We often walk by the river after dinner.
ex.zh: 我们经常在晚饭后沿河散步。

ex.en: People who exercise regularly often report better sleep and higher energy levels throughout the day.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼的人往往表示，他们睡得更好，白天也更有精力。

col: as often as possible｜尽可能经常
tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；t也可发音。

senses.en: a container with firm sides, often with a lid
to put something into a box
to compete in a sport using punches and protective gloves

ex.en: The kitten fell asleep inside an empty cardboard box.
ex.zh: 小猫在一个空纸箱里睡着了。

ex.en: Retailers can reduce packaging waste by choosing a box that closely matches the size of each product.
ex.zh: 零售商可以选择与每件商品大小相近的箱子，以减少包装浪费。

col: a box of chocolates｜一盒巧克力
tip: 复数为boxes；a box of后接盒中物品。

senses.en: to speak to someone or discuss something
a conversation or discussion between people
a speech given to an audience about a subject

ex.en: We talked about our weekend plans over breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们吃早饭时聊了聊周末的计划。

ex.en: Schools should encourage students to talk openly about stress and seek support when they need it.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生坦诚谈论压力，并在需要时寻求帮助。

tip: talk about接话题；talk to或with接人。

senses.en: A room where food is prepared and cooked

ex.en: The kitchen smells of fresh bread and roasted vegetables.
ex.zh: 厨房里飘着新鲜面包和烤蔬菜的香味。

ex.en: Shared kitchen facilities can encourage social interaction among students living in university accommodation away from home.
ex.zh: 共用厨房设施能促进离家住在大学宿舍的学生之间的社交互动。

tip: in the kitchen表示在厨房；ch读/tʃ/。

senses.en: To telephone someone or shout to get their attention.
To give someone or something a particular name.
A telephone conversation or a public request for action.

ex.en: I'll call you when I get home tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚到家后我会给你打电话。

ex.en: Environmental groups call for stricter regulations to reduce plastic waste entering rivers and oceans.
ex.zh: 环保团体呼吁制定更严格的法规，减少流入河流和海洋的塑料垃圾。

col: call for action｜呼吁采取行动
call someone back｜给某人回电话
tip: call sb表示给某人打电话，不加to。

senses.en: a flying insect that collects pollen; some kinds make honey

ex.en: A bee landed gently on the yellow flower.
ex.zh: 一只蜜蜂轻轻落在那朵黄花上。

ex.en: Protecting bees is essential for agriculture because these insects pollinate many crops that humans depend on.
ex.zh: 保护蜜蜂对农业至关重要，因为它们为许多人类赖以生存的作物授粉。

col: a swarm of bees｜一群蜜蜂
tip: bee与be同音；蜂群可用a swarm of bees。

senses.en: A kilogram, a unit used to measure mass.

ex.en: Could I have half a kilo of tomatoes, please?
ex.zh: 请给我半公斤西红柿，好吗？

ex.en: Comparing food prices per kilo can help households manage their budgets and make more economical purchasing decisions.
ex.zh: 比较食品每公斤的价格，有助于家庭管理预算，作出更经济的购买决定。

col: a kilo of rice｜一公斤大米
tip: kilo通常是kilogram的简称，不指公里。

senses.en: A length of time or a stage in history.
A scheduled length of time for a school lesson.
The monthly flow of blood from the uterus.

ex.en: We stayed indoors during a short period of heavy rain.
ex.zh: 在那阵短暂的大雨期间，我们一直待在室内。

ex.en: A prolonged period of unemployment can affect both financial security and mental health.
ex.zh: 长期失业既会影响经济保障，也会影响心理健康。

col: a period of time｜一段时间
tip: 表示一段时间常用a period of；美式英语也指句号。

senses.en: a plant or plant part eaten as food

ex.en: We bought fresh vegetables at the market this morning.
ex.zh: 我们今天早上在市场买了新鲜蔬菜。

ex.en: Schools can encourage healthier eating by serving a wider variety of vegetables at lunchtime.
ex.zh: 学校可以在午餐时供应更多种类的蔬菜，鼓励更健康的饮食。

tip: 通常为可数名词；泛指多种蔬菜用vegetables。

senses.en: to move something towards you or along by holding it
an act of pulling or a force drawing something closer
to injure a muscle by stretching it too much

ex.en: Please pull the door gently instead of pushing it.
ex.zh: 请轻轻拉门，不要推。

ex.en: Horses once pulled heavy loads through cities, but motor vehicles eventually replaced them in most transport roles.
ex.zh: 马匹曾在城市中拉运重物，但机动车最终取代了它们的大部分运输职能。

col: pull a door open｜把门拉开
tip: pull是朝自己方向拉；push是向外推。

senses.en: A hand covering with separate sections for fingers and thumb.

ex.en: I found my missing glove under the kitchen chair.
ex.zh: 我在厨房椅子下面找到了丢失的那只手套。

ex.en: Healthcare workers should change disposable gloves between patients to reduce the risk of spreading infections.
ex.zh: 医护人员在接诊不同患者之间应更换一次性手套，以降低传播感染的风险。

col: a pair of gloves｜一副手套
tip: 一副手套用 a pair of gloves，注意 gloves 用复数。

senses.en: used to refer to a person or group of people when speaking or writing to them

senses.zh: (You)人名；(柬)尤；(东南亚国家华语)猷

ex.en: Hi, Kelly. How are you?
ex.zh: 嗨，凯利，你好吗？

ex.en: You must all listen carefully.
ex.zh: 你们大家都必须仔细听着。

senses.en: Walk with firm, regular steps, often in a group.
An organised walk by a group, often to protest.
Music with a strong regular rhythm suitable for marching.

ex.en: The band marched through the square in bright uniforms.
ex.zh: 乐队身穿鲜艳的制服，齐步走过广场。

ex.en: Residents organised a peaceful march to demand safer roads and better public transport in their neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 居民组织了一场和平游行，要求改善社区道路安全和公共交通。

col: march through the streets｜列队穿过街道
tip: 小写march指行进；大写March指三月。

senses.zh: 检查；调查； 检测；考试
senses.en: to look at something carefully and thoroughly because you want to find out more about it

ex.en: A team of divers was sent down to examine the wreck.
ex.zh: 一组潜水员被送到水下检查沉船。

ex.en: Hegel’s philosophy will be examined in detail in Chapter 4.
ex.zh: 黑格尔的哲学将在第4章作详细探讨。

senses.en: something that happens because of an action or event
the final score or outcome of a test or competition
to happen because of something or cause something to happen

ex.en: The shiny floor was the result of hours of cleaning.
ex.zh: 这光亮的地板是花了好几个小时打扫的成果。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can result in lower emissions and shorter commuting times for urban residents.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通，可以减少排放并缩短城市居民的通勤时间。

tip: result in后接结果；result from后接原因。

senses.en: A feeling of happiness or enjoyment
An activity or experience that brings enjoyment

ex.en: She takes great pleasure in growing herbs on her balcony.
ex.zh: 她在阳台上种香草，从中获得很大的乐趣。

ex.en: Public libraries encourage reading for pleasure while providing affordable access to knowledge for people of all ages.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆鼓励以阅读为乐，同时让各年龄段的人都能以低廉的成本获取知识。

col: take pleasure in｜从……中获得乐趣
tip: 快乐通常不可数；一件乐事可说a pleasure。

senses.en: the number after three and before five

ex.en: We put four chairs around the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房桌子周围放了四把椅子。

ex.en: The research team compared four methods of reducing household energy use during the winter months.
ex.zh: 研究团队比较了四种减少冬季家庭能源消耗的方法。

tip: four是基数词；表示顺序“第四”用fourth。

senses.en: someone who is important in the early development of something, and whose work or ideas are later developed by other people
to be the first person to do, invent or use something
Facts or details about someone or something

ex.en: The receptionist gave us useful information about local buses.
ex.zh: 接待员向我们提供了有关当地公交车的实用信息。

ex.en: Access to reliable information enables patients to make better decisions about their treatment and long-term health.
ex.zh: 获取可靠信息能帮助患者就治疗和长期健康作出更好的决定。

col: access to information｜信息获取渠道
a piece of information｜一条信息
tip: 不可数：说some information，不说an information。

senses.en: People living together in an organised community.
An organisation for people who share an interest or purpose.

ex.en: Everyone has a part to play in society.
ex.zh: 每个人都能在社会中发挥作用。

ex.en: An ageing society requires accessible healthcare and policies that support older people's independence.
ex.zh: 老龄化社会需要便捷可及的医疗服务，以及支持老年人独立生活的政策。

col: society as a whole｜整个社会
tip: 泛指社会常不加the；表示协会时是可数名词。

senses.en: To examine things to find similarities and differences.
To describe something as similar to another thing.
To be as good as, or similar to, something else.

ex.en: We compared several backpacks before choosing the lightest one.
ex.zh: 我们比较了几个背包，最后选了最轻的那个。

ex.en: Researchers should compare the long-term costs of renewable energy with those of traditional power sources.
ex.zh: 研究人员应比较可再生能源与传统能源的长期成本。

col: compare A with B｜将A与B比较
compare A to B｜将A比作B；比较A和B
compare favourably with｜比起来不逊于
tip: 比较可用with或to；表示比喻时通常用to。

senses.en: To give someone something they need or make it available.
To support someone financially by supplying what they need.

ex.en: The campsite provides clean towels and blankets for every guest.
ex.zh: 营地为每位客人提供干净的毛巾和毯子。

ex.en: Local authorities should provide affordable public transport to ensure that all residents can access essential services.
ex.zh: 地方政府应提供价格可负担的公共交通，确保所有居民都能获得基本服务。

col: provide access to｜提供使用……的机会
provide someone with something｜向某人提供某物
tip: 用provide sb with sth或provide sth for sb。

senses.en: A person or organisation that something belongs to.

ex.en: The owner of the bakery greets us every morning.
ex.zh: 面包店老板每天早上都向我们打招呼。

ex.en: Property owners should maintain their buildings to ensure the safety of tenants and nearby residents.
ex.zh: 房产业主应维护其建筑，确保租户和附近居民的安全。

tip: 表示某物的所有者，用the owner of加名词。

senses.en: The star that gives Earth light and heat.
The light and warmth coming from the sun.
Sit or lie where sunlight warms your body.

ex.en: The sun appeared just as we reached the beach.
ex.zh: 我们刚到海滩，太阳就出来了。

ex.en: Energy from the sun can provide a renewable alternative to fossil fuels in regions with suitable conditions.
ex.zh: 在条件适宜的地区，太阳能可以成为化石燃料的可再生替代能源。

tip: 指太阳通常用the sun；in the sun表示在阳光下。

senses.en: every time or on every occasion
throughout all time or for ever

ex.en: My neighbour always waves when she sees me.
ex.zh: 我的邻居每次看见我都会挥手。

ex.en: Higher levels of economic growth do not always lead to better living conditions for every citizen.
ex.zh: 更高水平的经济增长并不总能让每位公民的生活条件得到改善。

tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；not always是并非总是。

senses.en: A method of doing something.
A route or direction leading somewhere.
By a large amount or distance.

ex.en: Show me an easier way to fold this sheet.
ex.zh: 教我一个更简单的叠床单方法吧。

ex.en: Improving public transport is an effective way to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通是减少交通拥堵和城市空气污染的有效方法。

col: an effective way｜一种有效的方法
tip: “做某事的方法”可用way to do或way of doing。
